nodes.label: Production Data Safety and Backward Compatibility
nodes.rationale: The CRM contains real production data, so surrounding code, backward compatibility, verification, and protection of unrelated changes take priority over broad rewrites.

nodes.label: Multi-site Isolation Invariant
nodes.rationale: Every business record and operation is scoped by sedeId, and cross-site identifiers return NOT_FOUND to avoid information disclosure.

nodes.label: Operational CRM UI Policy
nodes.rationale: The interface is a dense operational tool, so it favors semantic tokens, predictable responsive layouts, visible focus, and no global horizontal scrolling.

nodes.label: Storage Migration Safety Gate
nodes.rationale: A real migration must retain legacy reads and only run after a recent successful Drive backup and a verified dry-run.

nodes.label: Tars Proposes, Humans Approve
nodes.rationale: Tars may analyze and propose but cannot autonomously mutate business state.

nodes.label: Deterministic Reflex Pipeline
nodes.rationale: Simple high-volume classification belongs in a cheap, fast, testable pipeline rather than an expensive agent loop.

nodes.label: Tool-using Agentic Reasoning Loop
nodes.rationale: Ambiguous reconciliation and contradiction resolution require iterative search, backtracking, and changing hypotheses.

nodes.label: Capability-level Propose-not-execute Pattern
nodes.rationale: Safety is enforced by omitting write tools, not by asking the model to remember a policy; even a compromised model can only create a reviewable proposal.

nodes.label: Company Memory Store
nodes.rationale: Curated company knowledge captures conventions and preferences that prompt tuning alone cannot reliably supply; it is written by management and never inferred by the agent.

nodes.label: Trigger-specific Tool Profiles
nodes.rationale: Stable minimal tool catalogs reduce latency and token cost while improving tool selection.

nodes.label: Commessa Dossier Preload
nodes.rationale: Aggregating and preloading the known commessa context avoids reconstructing the same facts through many tool calls and removes an initial model-tool round trip.

nodes.label: Per-run Tool Cache
nodes.rationale: Caching is isolated to one execution to deduplicate reads without leaking stale or cross-context data between users or runs.

nodes.label: Actionable Human Clarification
nodes.rationale: An agent that can explicitly ask for missing information is less likely to invent data or produce low-confidence actions.

nodes.label: Explicit No-action Termination
nodes.rationale: Making no action a legitimate tool response reduces the pressure to produce noisy proposals merely to appear useful.

nodes.label: Layered Prompt Injection Defense
nodes.rationale: Defense combines no write capability, explicit untrusted-content delimiters, code-enforced site scope, and mandatory escalation of manipulation attempts.

nodes.label: Continuous Process Audit
nodes.rationale: Audits should react to measurable recurring patterns rather than isolated cases and must only propose bounded improvements.

nodes.label: Canonical Action Deduplication
nodes.rationale: Canonical action keys and title similarity stop reworded versions of already pending or decided actions from returning to the queue.

nodes.label: Proposal Approval Rate
nodes.rationale: Approval rate by action type is the primary quality signal because it directly measures whether proposals are useful rather than noisy.

nodes.label: Plus Jakarta Sans and JetBrains Mono Web Fonts
Favicon and Apple Touch Icon Reference
Idempotent Checksum-verified File Migration
nodes.rationale: Each object is written, read back, and SHA-256 verified before inline data is removed, making migration resumable and resistant to silent corruption.

nodes.label: Recent Google Drive Backup Precondition
nodes.rationale: Migration apply is refused unless a successful Drive backup exists within the previous 24 hours.

nodes.label: Legacy Inline Base64 Compatibility
nodes.rationale: Backup and reads continue supporting legacy inline records while storageKey becomes canonical.

nodes.label: Multi-site Data Isolation
nodes.rationale: Lists and mutations are scoped by the active site, and cross-site identifiers return 404 to prevent information leakage.

nodes.label: Document Gate with Explicit Bypass
nodes.rationale: Forward transitions require evidence uploaded in the current state, while an explicit force flag allows accountable human override without weakening transition rules.

nodes.label: Dedicated Communications Table
nodes.rationale: High-volume email and WhatsApp records use a dedicated PostgreSQL table with idempotent keys and tombstones instead of rewriting a single JSONB collection.

nodes.label: Durable Document Object Storage
nodes.rationale: Moving file bytes behind storageKey avoids rewriting all embedded base64 bytes on every persistedStore save while preserving legacy fallback behavior.

nodes.label: Embedded Payment Registry
nodes.rationale: importoIncassato is always derived server-side from payment rows so board, dashboard, and notifications share one calculation.

nodes.label: Commessa Marginality
nodes.rationale: Costs are entered in one commessa register to prevent double counting, and missing costs mark the margin incomplete rather than presenting a false 100 percent.

nodes.label: Tars Human Approval Architecture
nodes.rationale: Tars has read tools and persistent suggestions but no direct business writes; approval executes the same application mutations and permission checks as the UI.

nodes.label: Tars-led Communications Triage
nodes.rationale: Local heuristics are only non-binding signals; Tars classifies every new message, doubtful exclusions remain visible, and explicit sales opportunities override spam-like indicators.

nodes.label: Warm Operational Design System
nodes.rationale: Warm surfaces, semantic status colors, restrained radii, and responsive reflow support dense daily work without cold or decorative presentation.

nodes.label: Route-level Code Splitting
nodes.rationale: Lazy route loading and stable vendor chunks reduce initial payload while preserving independent browser caching.

nodes.label: Ephemeral-filesystem Object Storage Requirement
nodes.author: Manus AI
nodes.rationale: Railway application files are ephemeral across restarts and deploys, so durable media belongs in S3-compatible object storage.

nodes.label: Deploying a Node.js Project with MySQL on Railway
Ruffino Flow Technical and Operational Handoff
Site-scoped Security Invariants
nodes.rationale: Business reads and writes are bound to the active site, and NOT_FOUND prevents cross-site ID enumeration.

nodes.label: Tars Tool Profiles and Two-level Caching
Fail-open Communications Anti-noise Filter
nodes.rationale: Uncertain or unprocessed messages remain visible, while explicit requests for work outrank spam, newsletter, and sender-rule signals.

nodes.label: Rendered DOM Accessibility Testing
nodes.rationale: Meaningful accessibility violations arise from the rendered DOM in a real browser and cannot be established from JSX alone.

nodes.label: Separate Light and Dark Theme Audits
nodes.rationale: Dark-theme contrast must be measured independently instead of inferred from light-theme results.

nodes.label: Temporary Public axe-core Asset
nodes.rationale: The script is copied temporarily into public because Vite does not serve node_modules directly, then removed so it cannot enter a production build.

nodes.label: Mobile-first Field Operations
nodes.rationale: Field workflows are designed for one-handed smartphone use while office workflows expand for desktop.

nodes.label: Client-centered Information Architecture
nodes.author: Manus AI
nodes.rationale: The client is the information hub through which standardized commessa phases and connected operations are organized.

nodes.label: v3 Document Gate with Bypass
nodes.rationale: Evidence requirements are enforced server-side while force:true provides an explicit, UI-mediated exception without permitting invalid state jumps.

nodes.label: Orthogonal Soft Archive
nodes.rationale: Archival hides a commessa from operational views without changing its workflow state or deleting linked data.
